# Error code catalogue

Every error answer has the shape `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? }, "requestId" }`. The `code` is stable: clients switch on it, never on the message. The status never changes for a code (one table decides it, `src/common/constants/error-catalogue.ts`).

| Status | Code | Default message |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `MEDIA_INVALID` | The file is not valid. |
| 400 | `OTP_EXPIRED` | The code has expired. |
| 400 | `OTP_INVALID` | The code is not correct. |
| 400 | `SCHEDULE_OUT_OF_RANGE` | The scheduled time is outside the allowed range. |
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | The request is not valid. |
| 401 | `AUTH_REQUIRED` | Authentication is required. |
| 401 | `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | The phone, email or password is not correct. |
| 401 | `MFA_ENROLMENT_REQUIRED` | Set up two-factor authentication to continue. |
| 401 | `MFA_INVALID` | The verification code is not correct. |
| 401 | `MFA_REQUIRED` | A verification code from your authenticator app is required. |
| 402 | `VERIFICATION_FEE_REQUIRED` | The verification fee must be paid first. |
| 403 | `ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED` | This account is deactivated. |
| 403 | `ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING` | This account is pending deletion. |
| 403 | `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED` | This account is suspended. |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | You are not allowed to do this. |
| 403 | `LOCATION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED` | Location permission is required. |
| 403 | `MESSAGE_BLOCKED` | This message cannot be sent. |
| 403 | `OFFER_NOT_ELIGIBLE` | You cannot submit an offer on this errand. |
| 403 | `POLICY_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED` | You must accept the latest policy to continue. |
| 403 | `RATING_NOT_ELIGIBLE` | You cannot rate this errand. |
| 403 | `REGISTRATION_BLOCKED` | Registration is not available for this phone number or email. |
| 403 | `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_ACTIVE` | An active subscription is required. |
| 403 | `USER_BLOCKED` | This action is not available between these users. |
| 403 | `VERIFICATION_PENDING` | Your verification is still pending. |
| 403 | `VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` | Identity verification is required. |
| 404 | `LOCATION_NOT_AVAILABLE` | Location is not available. |
| 404 | `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | The requested resource was not found. |
| 409 | `ASSIGNMENT_ACCEPTANCE_EXPIRED` | The acceptance window has expired. |
| 409 | `ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT` | Another action was completed first. |
| 409 | `ASSIGNMENT_INVALID_STATE` | This assignment cannot be changed in its current state. |
| 409 | `BOOST_NOT_ELIGIBLE` | This errand cannot be boosted. |
| 409 | `CHANGE_REQUEST_NOT_ALLOWED` | A change request is not allowed at this stage. |
| 409 | `CHANGE_REQUEST_PENDING` | A change request is already pending. |
| 409 | `CONVERSATION_READ_ONLY` | This conversation is read-only. |
| 409 | `DELETION_BLOCKED` | The account cannot be deleted yet. |
| 409 | `DISPUTE_ALREADY_OPEN` | A dispute is already open. |
| 409 | `DUPLICATE_IDENTITY` | This identity is already registered. |
| 409 | `ERRAND_EXPIRED` | This errand has expired. |
| 409 | `ERRAND_INVALID_STATE` | This errand cannot be modified in its current state. |
| 409 | `GOOGLE_SIGNUP_REQUIRED` | There is no account for this Google user yet. Accept the policies to create one. |
| 409 | `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` | This idempotency key was already used with a different request. |
| 409 | `IDENTIFIER_TAKEN` | This phone number or email is already registered. |
| 409 | `MEDIA_NOT_READY` | The file is still being processed. |
| 409 | `OFFER_ALREADY_EXISTS` | You already have an active offer on this errand. |
| 409 | `OFFER_AWAITING_RUNNER` | This offer is waiting for the runner to respond. |
| 409 | `OFFER_INVALID_STATE` | This offer cannot be changed in its current state. |
| 409 | `OFFER_NEEDS_RECONFIRMATION` | The runner must reconfirm this offer. |
| 409 | `OFFER_VERSION_MISMATCH` | The offer changed. Review the latest version. |
| 409 | `RATING_ALREADY_SUBMITTED` | You have already rated this errand. |
| 409 | `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state. |
| 422 | `ERRAND_NOT_ELIGIBLE` | This errand is not eligible for this action. |
| 422 | `VERIFICATION_FAILED` | Identity verification failed. |
| 429 | `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` | Too many failed attempts. Try again later. |
| 429 | `OFFER_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED` | You have reached today's offer limit. |
| 429 | `OTP_RATE_LIMITED` | Too many codes requested. Try again later. |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests. Try again later. |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | An unexpected error occurred. |
| 502 | `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED` | The code could not be sent. Try again. |
| 503 | `FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is temporarily unavailable. |
| 503 | `PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | The payment service is not available right now. Try again in a moment. |
| 503 | `SIGN_IN_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | Google sign-in is not available right now. Use your phone or email instead. |
